faq.q: Is February a good time for a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, if you want calm seas, fewer crowds, and lower prices. February averages 15-16°C sea temperature and 12-18°C air, with about 6 rain days. You'll need a jacket, but the sun often breaks through. Choose an enclosed flybridge like the Azimut 39 for comfort.

faq.q: What should I wear for a February yacht trip in Marbella?
faq.a: Layer up: a thermal base, fleece, and a waterproof windbreaker. Bring a hat and gloves for the breeze. Non-slip shoes are essential. The boat provides blankets, but you'll appreciate warm clothing between sun loungers.

faq.q: Which boat is best for February in Marbella?
faq.a: The Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) has an enclosed saloon and flybridge, ideal for cooler days. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers ample covered space. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: How rough is the sea in February off Marbella?
faq.a: Generally calm, with typical swells of 0.5-1m. However, a Levante wind can bring short choppy waves, especially east of Marbella. Your skipper monitors forecasts and may adjust the route to sheltered coves like Cala del Faro.

faq.q: Can I swim or do water sports in February?
faq.a: Swimming is possible but brisk—sea temps hover around 15-16°C. A wetsuit helps. Jet skis are available on the Mangusta 80 charter (free), and you can still enjoy paddleboarding if you're hardy. Most guests prefer scenic cruising and beach stops.

faq.q: What is the average sunshine in February in Marbella?
faq.a: You can expect about 6-7 hours of daily sunshine, with roughly 7-8 partly cloudy days. The sun is low, so UV is weak, but you should still wear sunscreen on exposed skin. Morning cruises often have clearer skies than afternoons.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a February charter?
faq.a: Book 2-3 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time. February is low season, so you'll find good availability, but weekends can fill up. Contact us via WhatsApp for current pricing and last-minute options.

faq.q: What happens if it rains on my charter day?
faq.a: Your skipper will adjust the route to minimise exposure, using covered decks and the saloon. If conditions are unsafe, we offer rescheduling or a full refund. Check our cancellation policy when booking—flexibility is key in winter.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter weather February 2049? You're in for a treat: February in Marbella offers mild, often sunny days with a fraction of summer crowds. Sea temperatures hover around 15-16°C, air temps range 12-18°C, and rain is limited to about 6 days. With the right boat and a flexible skipper, you can enjoy a memorable winter cruise along the Costa del Sol. This guide gives you the numbers, the best boats, and the insider tips to make your February charter a success.

February Weather Snapshot for Marbella

February is one of Marbella's cooler months, but it's far from bleak. Here's what to expect:

  • Air temperature: 12-18°C (average high 16°C, low 12°C)
  • Sea temperature: 15-16°C – brisk but not freezing
  • Rain: ~6 rainy days, 40-60mm total
  • Wind: 8-12 kts typical, with occasional Levante (east wind) gusts up to 20 kts
  • Sunshine: 6-7 hours per day, with clear mornings often giving way to afternoon clouds

Compared to northern Europe, it's positively balmy. The key is to dress in layers and choose a boat with covered areas.

Why February Can Be a Great Month to Charter

February offers a unique blend of low-season tranquillity and decent weather. You'll find:

  • Fewer boats – Puerto Banús is quieter, so you get more space and personal attention.
  • Lower prices – Many operators offer off-peak rates (though our Tier A boats are fixed at €749 for 2 hours).
  • Calm seas – Swells are typically under 1m, making for a smooth ride.
  • Wildlife – Dolphins are often spotted in the Strait of Gibraltar area, and seabirds are abundant.

Just be flexible: if a storm front rolls in, your skipper will adjust the route or you can reschedule.

Best Boats for February Conditions

For cooler days, prioritise comfort and shelter. Our Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) has an enclosed saloon and flybridge, perfect for staying warm while enjoying views. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers vast covered deck space and a free jet ski – great for brave souls. If you want a sportier feel, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) has a hard top and fast cruising. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What's Included in Every February Charter

No hidden extras – every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

So you can just show up and enjoy. For pricing, see our full fleet and rates – Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Other boats are on request via WhatsApp.

February Sailing Routes and Stops

With 6-7 hours of daylight, you can plan a leisurely cruise. Popular winter routes:

  • Puerto Banús to Marbella Marina – 20 minutes, great for a quick lunch stop.
  • Puerto Banús to Cabopino – 45 minutes, with a chance to see the dunes.
  • Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro – 30 minutes, a sheltered cove perfect for a picnic.
  • Puerto Banús to Estepona – 1 hour, with views of La Concha mountain.

Your skipper will choose based on wind and sea state. Remember, February seas can be lively, so trust their expertise.

Dress Code and Packing List for February

Layering is your best friend. Here's a practical checklist:

  • Thermal base layer (merino or synthetic)
  • Fleece or light jumper
  • Waterproof windbreaker
  • Warm hat and gloves
  • Non-slip deck shoes
  • Sunscreen (even in winter, UV reflects off water)
  • Sunglasses and a camera

Boats have blankets, but you'll be glad you brought your own. If you plan to swim, a wetsuit is recommended – the sea is around 15°C.

How to Book Your February Charter

Booking is simple: browse our fleet page, choose your boat, and contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94, we'll send a tailored quote. February is low season, so you have flexibility, but weekends fill up fast – book 2-3 weeks ahead.
